title: Unified IoMT laboratory dataset (Phase 1) — column dictionary

sources.description: Public IoMT benchmark (UNB/CIC). Rows are MIOTTA-NPT windows from PCAP captures.
Public IoMT hospital-style testbed traffic (INESC TEC / University of Coimbra). MIOTTA-NPT windows from PCAP captures.

summary.split_policy: Stratified 70% train / 15% validation / 15% test on label_category (seed=42).
summary.scaling: StandardScaler fit on TRAIN features only; same transform applied to val/test (no leakage). Scaler saved as scaler.joblib next to this metadata.
feature_pipeline: Raw PCAPs per dataset are processed externally by MIOTTA-NPT (combined mode, window size W=100 packets).
Each MIOTTA CSV row is one statistical feature vector for a window.
Rows from both sources are concatenated with provenance columns.
QA: drop high-NaN features, impute remaining NaNs with 0, replace infinities, drop zero-variance numeric columns.
Near-zero-variance columns are flagged (see flagged_but_not_removed and summary.near_zero_variance_feature_names) but are NOT dropped by the code.
Duplicate rows (identical feature vectors) are removed.
All numeric features cast to float32.
summary.near_zero_variance_note: Variance > 0 but below 1e-8 on the unified pre-split frame. These columns are numerically almost constant but are still present in train/val/test CSV exports.

code_references.implementation: src/pipeline/quality.py — treat_missing_values (NaN drop), remove_zero_variance, detect_near_zero_variance (flag only)

steps.rule: Drop any numeric feature whose NaN rate exceeds NAN_THRESHOLD (0.5 = 50%). Remaining NaNs in kept columns are imputed with 0.
steps.reason_summary_en: Columns missing for most rows carry little usable signal and would dominate as missingness artefacts; the pipeline drops them.

columns_removed.name: fin_flag_number
columns_removed.reason_plain_en: Almost always missing in the merged MIOTTA tables — likely a legacy/alternate TCP FIN counter not populated in this export (active flag counts use columns such as fin_count).

columns_removed.name: syn_flag_number
columns_removed.reason_plain_en: Same pattern as fin_flag_number — unused/legacy SYN counter field.

columns_removed.name: rst_flag_number
columns_removed.reason_plain_en: Same pattern — unused legacy RST counter field.

columns_removed.name: psh_flag_number
columns_removed.reason_plain_en: Same pattern — unused legacy PSH counter field.

columns_removed.name: ack_flag_number
columns_removed.reason_plain_en: Same pattern — unused legacy ACK counter field.

columns_removed.name: ece_flag_number
columns_removed.reason_plain_en: Same pattern — unused legacy ECE counter field.

columns_removed.name: cwr_flag_number
columns_removed.reason_plain_en: Same pattern — unused legacy CWR counter field.

columns_removed.name: tcp_flags_ece
columns_removed.reason_plain_en: Same pattern — redundant/unpopulated ECE-related field in this export (ECE-related behaviour is represented elsewhere, e.g. tcp_flags_cwr and aggregate TCP statistics).

steps.rule: After NaN handling, drop any numeric feature whose variance on the full unified frame (pre-split) is exactly 0.
steps.reason_summary_en: A column that never changes carries no discriminative information for supervised learning and can cause numerical issues in some models.

columns_removed.name: DHCP
columns_removed.reason_plain_en: Constant across the unified corpus — DHCP traffic effectively absent in these PCAP-derived windows for both IoMT sources.

columns_removed.name: ARP
columns_removed.reason_plain_en: Constant (zero variance) on the unified table for this MIOTTA configuration — no usable cross-row variation.

columns_removed.name: IPV4
columns_removed.reason_plain_en: Constant indicator in this export — no cross-row variation after MIOTTA processing.

columns_removed.name: LLC
columns_removed.reason_plain_en: Constant — LLC-layer signal does not vary across rows in this combined-mode feature extract.

columns_removed.name: Drate
columns_removed.reason_plain_en: Degenerate column (zero variance) on the merged dataset — likely numerically redundant with other rate statistics.

columns_removed.name: Fwd_Data_Pkts_Tot
columns_removed.reason_plain_en: Zero variance on the unified table — forward data-plane packet total does not vary in the retained representation; related information remains in other directional counters.

columns_removed.name: Bwd_Data_Pkts_Tot
columns_removed.reason_plain_en: Zero variance on the unified table — backward analogue of Fwd_Data_Pkts_Tot.

removed_numeric_features.note_on_provenance: These removals apply only to MIOTTA numeric feature columns. Provenance columns (attack_type, source_file, source_dataset, attack_group) and harmonised labels (label_binary, label_category, label_fine) are added separately and are not part of the 73→58 count.

flagged_but_not_removed.rule: Variance > 0 but < NEAR_ZERO_VAR_THRESHOLD (1e-8) — flagged for documentation only; columns are NOT dropped by this step.
flagged_but_not_removed.reason_summary_en: Numerically almost constant but still technically variable; kept so exported CSV/Parquet, scaler.joblib, and published experiments stay aligned.

duplicate_rows_removed.rule: Remove rows that are exact duplicates on the numeric feature vector (first occurrence kept).
duplicate_rows_removed.note: This removes duplicate windows, not columns. Last logged notebook run: 596,662 rows (~6.93% of the pre-dedup unified frame). Re-run the pipeline if raw inputs change — counts are data-dependent.

evidence_note_en: The dropped-column names and NaN rates were captured from the Phase 1 QA stdout in notebooks/07_phase1_iomt_unification.ipynb (unified CICIoMT2024 + IoMT-TrafficData run). If MIOTTA versions or PCAP subsets change, re-run QA — the dropped set may differ.
how_to_read_this_file: Read `removed_numeric_features` first to see which MIOTTA columns were dropped during QA and why (73 → 58).
Use `columns` for every model input feature in order of training.
Use `metadata_columns` + `label_columns` for human-readable semantics and interview answers.
For formal MIOTTA definitions of each statistic, cite the MIOTTA-NPT paper/tool documentation; this JSON summarises intent in plain language.

columns.name: Window
columns.description: Sliding packet-window index within the flow (MIOTTA windowing).

columns.name: Header_Length
columns.description: Aggregate header length statistics for packets in the window.

columns.name: Protocol_Type
columns.description: Encoded dominant protocol type observed in the window.

columns.name: TTL
columns.description: Time-to-live field statistics (IP layer) within the window.

columns.name: HTTP
columns.description: HTTP traffic indicator / count in the window.

columns.name: HTTPS
columns.description: HTTPS (TLS) traffic indicator / count in the window.

columns.name: DNS
columns.description: DNS traffic indicator / count in the window.

columns.name: Telnet
columns.description: Telnet traffic indicator / count in the window.

columns.name: SMTP
columns.description: SMTP traffic indicator / count in the window.

columns.name: SSH
columns.description: SSH traffic indicator / count in the window.

columns.name: IRC
columns.description: IRC traffic indicator / count in the window.

columns.name: TCP
columns.description: TCP traffic indicator / count in the window.

columns.name: UDP
columns.description: UDP traffic indicator / count in the window.

columns.name: ICMP
columns.description: ICMP traffic indicator / count in the window.

columns.name: IGMP
columns.description: IGMP traffic indicator / count in the window (often near-zero in these sources).

columns.name: IAT
columns.description: Inter-arrival time statistics aggregated at window level.

columns.name: Tot_size
columns.description: Total packet size (bytes) aggregated in the window.

columns.name: tcp_analysis_initial_rtt
columns.description: Initial RTT estimate from TCP analysis.

columns.name: tcp_connection_fin
columns.description: TCP FIN flag / connection-teardown related signal in the window.

columns.name: tcp_connection_syn
columns.description: TCP SYN flag / connection-establishment related signal in the window.

columns.name: tcp_flags_cwr
columns.description: TCP CWR (congestion window reduced) flag statistics.

columns.name: tcp_urgent_pointer
columns.description: TCP urgent pointer usage statistics.

columns.name: ip_frag_offset
columns.description: IP fragmentation offset related statistics.

columns.name: eth_src_not_group
columns.description: Ethernet source not in known group (link-layer heuristic signal).

columns.name: Rate
columns.description: Overall packet or byte rate in the window (throughput-style feature).

columns.name: Srate
columns.description: Secondary rate feature (directional or smoothed rate component).

columns.name: ack_count
columns.description: Count of TCP ACK segments observed in the window.

columns.name: syn_count
columns.description: Count of TCP SYN segments observed in the window.

columns.name: fin_count
columns.description: Count of TCP FIN segments observed in the window.

columns.name: rst_count
columns.description: Count of TCP RST segments observed in the window.

columns.name: Bytes
columns.description: Byte volume statistics for traffic in the window.

columns.name: Min_Length
columns.description: Minimum packet length observed in the window.

columns.name: Max_Length
columns.description: Maximum packet length observed in the window.

columns.name: Avg_Length
columns.description: Average packet length in the window.

columns.name: Std_Length
columns.description: Standard deviation of packet lengths in the window.

columns.name: Number
columns.description: Packet count or flow cardinality style statistic for the window.

columns.name: Magnite
columns.description: Magnitude statistic of the flow/window (MIOTTA combined feature).

columns.name: Radius
columns.description: Radius statistic describing spread of packet sizes/timing (MIOTTA).

columns.name: Covariance
columns.description: Covariance between forward/backward size or timing components.

columns.name: Var_Ratio
columns.description: Variance ratio between directional components (forward vs backward).

columns.name: Weight
columns.description: Weighted aggregate statistic used by MIOTTA combined mode.

columns.name: Orig_Bytes
columns.description: Bytes observed on the originator (forward) direction.

columns.name: Resp_Bytes
columns.description: Bytes observed on the responder (backward) direction.

columns.name: Orig_Pkts
columns.description: Packet count on the originator (forward) direction.

columns.name: Resp_Pkts
columns.description: Packet count on the responder (backward) direction.

columns.name: Fwd_Pkts_Tot
columns.description: Total forward-direction packets in the window.

columns.name: Bwd_Pkts_Tot
columns.description: Total backward-direction packets in the window.

columns.name: Fwd_Pkts_Per_Sec
columns.description: Forward packets per second (window-normalised rate).

columns.name: Bwd_Pkts_Per_Sec
columns.description: Backward packets per second (window-normalised rate).

columns.name: Flow_Pkts_Per_Sec
columns.description: Total flow packets per second (window-normalised rate).

columns.name: Fwd_Header_Size
columns.description: Forward-direction header size aggregate.

columns.name: Bwd_Header_Size
columns.description: Backward-direction header size aggregate.

columns.name: Fwd_Pkts_Payload
columns.description: Forward-direction payload bytes aggregate.

columns.name: Bwd_Pkts_Payload
columns.description: Backward-direction payload bytes aggregate.

columns.name: Flow_Pkts_Payload
columns.description: Total payload bytes across both directions in the window.

columns.name: Fwd_IAT
columns.description: Forward inter-arrival time statistics (often low variance in some captures).

columns.name: Bwd_IAT
columns.description: Backward inter-arrival time statistics.

columns.name: Flow_IAT
columns.description: End-to-end flow inter-arrival time statistics.

metadata_columns.name: attack_type
metadata_columns.description: Exact attack/benign label string inferred from the MIOTTA CSV filename (after prefix/suffix stripping).

metadata_columns.name: attack_group
metadata_columns.description: For CICIoMT2024: attack_type with trailing numeric variant suffix removed so keys match the harmonisation map (e.g. ...-ICMP3 -> ...-ICMP). For IoMT-TrafficData: identical to attack_type.

metadata_columns.name: source_file
metadata_columns.description: Original MIOTTA output CSV filename this row was loaded from.

metadata_columns.name: source_dataset
metadata_columns.description: Logical dataset name: 'CICIoMT2024' or 'IoMT-TrafficData'. Used to build single-source training regimes (B1/B2) and slice-wise evaluation.

label_columns.name: label_binary
label_columns.description: Binary intrusion target derived from label_category.

label_columns.name: label_category
label_columns.description: Six-class teaching target used in the thesis experiments (MQTT scheme). MQTT-specific attacks are grouped under 'MQTT' instead of being folded into DoS/Recon.

label_columns.name: label_fine
label_columns.description: Fine-grained label: for CICIoMT2024 equals attack_group; for IoMT-TrafficData mapped via IOMT_FINE_MAP to a stable snake_case taxonomy.

other_variant.difference: In 'nature' scheme, MQTT floods map to DoS/DDoS/Injection-style categories instead of a dedicated MQTT class. Feature list is the same 58 columns.
